articles.summary: NEW YORK , Dec. 18, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SunCar Technology Group Inc. (the "Company" or "SunCar") (NASDAQ: SDA), an innovative leader in AI cloud-based B2B auto eInsurance and auto services in China , today reported third quarter 2025 financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2025 .
articles.title: SunCar Technology Reports Third Quarter 2025 Results
